scope: Diagnosis on already inspected engineering test scores; these thresholds must not select or calibrate v56
finding: The ranking retains substantially more spam at lower thresholds, but FP increase. A single global ham-maximum threshold loses old spam disproportionately.

testHamLanguageAudit.definition: More than 25% of alphabetic characters in the first 1800 characters of the v55 normalized context view; CJK means Japanese, Chinese or Korean Unicode blocks. Descriptive test audit, not a fitting feature or a verified language detector.

boundaryBug: A float64 nextafter boundary rounds back to a float32 score during NumPy array comparison. v56 steps in the original score dtype and uses float64 gate comparisons.
v56: Reuse frozen v54 and v55. Fit a small consensus gate on part of v55 selection families, choose it on different selection families, calibrate on untouched v55 calibration, and evaluate fixed models on matched test identities.
limitations: Reused engineering corpora. Frozen v54 may have trained on relatives of legacy holdout. Sparse legitimate multilingual coverage. Neither a threshold diagnosis nor a green workflow validates production quality.
